source_meaning: Two vacua or spaces at the same location.
technical_translation: Absence of coupling: co-located states remain isolated because phase, sheet, orientation, address or mode tags are incompatible.
caveat: Not a second physical vacuum or guaranteed physical barrier.

technical_translation: Discrete state label σ, often Z2, that partitions compatibility sectors.
caveat: Needs explicit semantics; merely duplicating coordinates is not a physics model.

technical_translation: Route, sheet, freshness, admission or validity flag under a declared schema.
caveat: The bit is not the full optical, geometric, biological or semantic state.

technical_translation: Quantity or relation preserved by specified transformations.
caveat: Must be defined and proven for the chosen dynamics.

source_meaning: Identity persists through split/merge and coordinate change.
technical_translation: Generative identifier plus parent/transition history.
caveat: A proposed data-model concept; 64-bit uniqueness and reconstruction claims require collision and branch rules.

technical_translation: Discrete path in a hybrid dynamical system or event tree.
caveat: Branch explosion is a stated scaling risk.

technical_translation: Finite rules that generate relations, trajectories or structures.
caveat: Expression size and algebraic closure can grow rapidly.

source_meaning: Store only novelty not generated by the grammar.
technical_translation: Append-only event log of external interventions/shocks used with seed and grammar for reconstruction.
caveat: External novelty and branch history still accumulate.

source_meaning: Memory grows with novelty rather than geometric extent.
technical_translation: Regenerate deterministic closed dynamics; log irreducible external events and lineage.
caveat: Not zero memory; expression and log growth can dominate.

technical_translation: Evaluate a closed or bounded state expression at requested time without replaying all intermediate frames.
caveat: Cost depends on expression size, conditioning and branch history.

technical_translation: Find the earliest compatible root/guard crossing after t0.
caveat: Multiple roots, tangencies, dense events and degeneracies can be hard.

technical_translation: Array position 35 is the 36th item when indexing begins at zero.
caveat: This does not change arithmetic; 21+7+7 remains 35.

source_meaning: Conventional spatial filter criticized as a trap.
technical_translation: Acceleration structures for pruning spatial intersection candidates.
caveat: They are not inherently obsolete; analytic supports and compatibility filters are alternative pruning methods with their own costs.

source_meaning: Frontend sensor problem and collision tunneling.
technical_translation: Ambiguous acronym: charge-coupled device in imaging; continuous collision detection in simulation.
caveat: The corpus deliberately mixes the two meanings.
source_anchors: DMT pp.15-18; Chronological pp.7-10; ADDominUS pp.21-22

source_meaning: Mistaking sampled projection for world ontology.
technical_translation: Critique of frame-by-frame materialization when direct relation/event queries suffice.
caveat: Rasterization and sampling remain valid downstream tools and often necessary numerical methods.

technical_translation: Table addressed by ρ=ln r and θ; useful for scale-to-translation mapping and foveated/local processing.
caveat: Quantization, singular origin, interpolation and information loss must be measured.
source_anchors: DMT pp.2-3,9-18; Hollowland pp.12-17; KC Vector Art pp.1-10

technical_translation: Emit an event only when support, compatibility and measured guard conditions pass, with confidence and lineage.
caveat: Requires a digital sidecar and declared thresholds; not mystical gating.

technical_translation: At most: horizon-independent evaluation for a fixed closed expression.
caveat: Event solving, compatibility, expression growth and branching are not universally constant.

source_meaning: Infinite world stored as equations only.
technical_translation: Potential reduction by regeneration from seed/grammar and logging novelty.
caveat: Parameters, calibration, external logs, branches and numerical state consume memory.

source_meaning: One algebraic substrate fuses physics and cognition.
technical_translation: Research hypothesis about shared representation for perception, state and action.
caveat: No learning rule, semantic grounding, benchmark or model compression proof is supplied.
